items.title: Unit tests pass
items.description: Verify isolated Seed-critical behavior through the repository test suite.
items.method: Run npm test from the repository root as the shared test producer.
evidence_required: Exact npm test command and exit status.
Complete passing summary or failing diagnostics from all test files.
Confirmation that fixture repositories and homes were disposable and cleaned.

items.title: Integration tests pass
items.description: Verify integrated CLI and filesystem workflows through the repository test suite.
items.method: Run npm test from the repository root as the shared test producer.
evidence_required: Exact npm test command and exit status.
Complete passing summary or failing diagnostics from all test files.
Confirmation that fixture repositories and homes were disposable and cleaned.

items.title: Repository README is accurate and safely executable
items.description: Verify @repo-readme contains the actual project entrypoint information, inventory every shell command, and use @seed-evidence-scripts to exercise safe real CLI paths only in disposable repository and user-home locations.
items.method: Reuse npm test as the shared test producer, then run node seed/scripts/verify-readme.js from the repository root. The verifier classifies every README shell command, rejects unknown command forms, and executes representative project, genome, verification, named-Seed, and skill-installation paths under a temporary repository, HOME, CODEX_HOME, and CLAUDE_HOME that it removes in a finally block. Network/global-install, placeholder, interactive pager, and terminal evidence-transition examples are inspected but not executed.
evidence_required: Exact npm test and README verifier commands with exit statuses.
Confirmation that repository files and real user skill homes were unchanged.

items.title: Repository license is explicit and consistent
items.description: Verify the authoritative license text and every repository artifact that actually declares the root package license agree on MIT without treating dependency licenses or README prose as project license declarations.
items.method: Run node seed/scripts/verify-license.js from the repository root. The verifier parses package.json and package-lock.json, checks the root package entries, and validates the identifying MIT text in LICENSE with complete assertion diagnostics on mismatch.
evidence_required: Exact verifier command and exit status.
Parsed root package and lockfile license identifiers.

items.title: Seed language and reference behavior passes
items.description: Exercise real parsing, validation, requirements, artifact, policy, default and named path, and cross-Seed reference behavior from @source-contract through @test-contract.
items.method: Run node --test test/validation.test.js test/seed-file.test.js test/external-references.test.js from the repository root.
evidence_required: Passing test summary or complete failing diagnostics.
Confirmation that tests used temporary repositories and did not alter production state.

items.title: Built-in genome catalog and compiler passes
items.description: Validate every packaged genome and exercise lookup, composition, selectors, exclusions, merge semantics, provenance, and failure paths.
items.method: Run node src/cli.js genome validate --builtin and node --test test/genomes.test.js from the repository root.
evidence_required: Both exact commands and exit statuses.
Validated built-in count and passing focused test summary.
Full diagnostics for any invalid genome or failed compiler case.

items.title: Non-visual CLI workflows pass
items.description: Exercise repository routing, named Seeds, references, validation, diffs, verification transitions, large machine output, and @portable-skill installation without treating terminal presentation assertions as master acceptance.
items.method: Run npm test from the repository root as the shared test producer.
evidence_required: Exact npm test command and exit status.
Passing summary or complete CLI workflow diagnostics.
Confirmation that temporary homes and repositories were disposable and cleaned.

items.title: ANSI-free output preserves semantic content
items.description: Exercise non-TTY, NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, and supported --no-color paths and confirm they suppress ANSI without losing readable command content.
items.method: Run npm test from the repository root as the shared test producer.
evidence_required: Exact npm test command and exit status.
Passing terminal-markdown and CLI assertions for every ANSI-suppression path.
Complete diagnostics if plain output loses content or contains unexpected ANSI.

items.title: Failed skill replacement restores the prior installation
items.description: Use @seed-evidence-scripts to inject a controlled failure after the existing skill has been moved to its backup and prove the real CLI fails nonzero without losing prior content or leaving a partial staged target.
items.method: Run node seed/scripts/verify-skill-installer-rollback.js from the repository root using only the disposable CODEX_HOME created and removed by the script.
evidence_required: Exact verifier command and exit status.
Nonzero nested CLI result and preserved controlled-failure diagnostics.
Intact prior marker plus absence of partial target, backup, and staging paths.

items.title: Verification ledger behavior passes
items.description: Exercise claims, leases, locks, evidence commands, hashes, expiry, reconciliation, replay, refresh, audit, report, completion, and sync.
items.method: Run node --test test/verification-store.test.js from the repository root.
evidence_required: Passing summary or complete state-machine diagnostics.
Confirmation that only disposable fixture repositories were mutated.

items.title: Unpublished npm package surface is reproducible
items.description: Inspect the npm-compatible pack result without publishing or writing a production package artifact.
items.method: Run npm pack --dry-run --json from the repository root and inspect its file list.
evidence_required: Package name, version, executable mode, and included file inventory.
Confirmation that src, resources, README, package metadata, and license are present and tests are absent.

items.title: Master contract boundaries remain honest
items.description: Inspect the complete constructed blueprint and confirm requirements is empty, authoritative artifacts exist, only honest genome subsets are active, and deferred presentation or near-fit work remains outside master.
items.method: Run seed validate and seed blueprint --json from the repository root, then inspect all sections and artifacts.
evidence_required: Complete blueprint item and global-policy counts.
Artifact existence review and deferred-boundary confirmation.
